title: Professions
source: User-provided workbook photo, manually transcribed; Word File German translations suggested separately

entries.description: The person you visit when you are ill
A person who looks after sick people in hospital
The person who looks after your teeth
A person who repairs cars
A person who fixes lights and cables in a house
